caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate pitcher situated at the center of a plain background. The pitcher is rendered in shades of brown and gold, giving it a metallic, possibly bronze or brass appearance. Its form is traditional with a wide body, a narrow neck, a flared spout, and an elaborately curved handle. The surface of the pitcher is highly decorated with raised relief scenes; prominently on the main body, there is an intricate depiction featuring human figures, possibly engaged in a mythological or heroic activity, surrounded by elaborate foliage and scrollwork. The overall texture and coloration suggest the pitcher has a polished, reflective finish, and the detailed relief work covers much of the visible side, framed by decorative motifs along the top and near the base. The artist’s signature appears in the lower right corner of the drawing. The background is a solid, off-white color, which contrasts with the warm hues of the pitcher and allows the details to stand out clearly.
title: Rockingham Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
